name: public-profile
notes: Re-baselined 2026-10-07 to migrations through 20261006000021 (v2). v1 described 0001-0012.
Healthcare details are provider-claimed, never verified; verification.credentials appears only after admin review.
mapLocation is rounded to 2 decimals (~1 km) by public_profile_json (20261006000016_public_projection.sql:110-111), only when the provider consented (show_map_location).
moderationStatus is never emitted: public_profile_json is an explicit allowlist (20261006000016) asserted by 0007_public_projection.test.sql.
verification lists only kinds whose latest status is approved (20261006000016:103-107); pending/rejected credentials are never public.

Healthcare variant: this listing is a dentist, which is NOT approved for launch (phase-009 pilot; seed.sql sets is_approved_for_launch=false and the healthcare_listings flag is off). Against launch data it is not listed at all and get_public_profile returns null. The shape is kept so the healthcareDetails contract stays tested for when healthcare opens.

body.description: General dentistry and scaling. Appointments preferred.

healthcareDetails.clinicAddress: Demo Building, Hill Road, Bandra West (fictional)

error.description: Unknown, draft, paused or suspended id. SQL returns JSON null with HTTP 200 (not an exception); the Dart adapter converts null to NOT_FOUND or returns null (publicProfileById is Future<ProviderProfile?>).

error.message: Listing not found or not public.
